entities.summary: Kirill Yuryevich Yeskov, also transliterated Kiril Eskov is a Russian writer, biologist and paleontologist. As an author he is known for The Gospel of Afranius in which he presents an atheistic interpretation of the events of the Gospel, and The Last Ringbearer in which he retells J. R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings from a Mordorian point of view.
